thread:
maria_cs: Quick weekly check-in for Sparrow — focusing on caching + batching effectiveness. High-level: hit rate improved from 18% -> 32% after the prefix-key patch, avg batch size drifted from 4.2 -> 3.6 last 24h, cost per 1k tokens dropped from $12.4 -> $9.1. Sending plots after this. Any immediate concerns?

jake_csm: Nice improvement. Do we have the rollout timeline and which clients got the change? Also saw a small uptick in client-side 429s — could be batching.

rahul_infra: Rollout: 03/12 02:10 UTC -> Canary (10% traffic), 03/12 06:00 UTC -> 50%, 03/12 12:00 UTC -> 100%. Change was prefix-key normalization + increased cache window. We also tuned batcher heuristics. 429s correlate with a spike in average batch latency around 11:45 UTC. Looking into a backpressure misconfig.

anika_success: Customer feedback from Sparrow eng: "hit-rate looks great, but our requests became burstier after we turned on the client-side batching lib" — they asked for a recommended client config. I'll send a sample and offer a 30-min enablement call.

maria_cs: Please paste the sample here, small snippet is fine. Also, renewal check — Sparrow's committed spend is approaching threshold; recommend we quantify savings and propose a renewal incentive if they commit to a 6mo Dedicated slot.

anika_success: Sample client config (JS):
```
// recommended batching config for Sparrow - start conservative
const batching = {
  maxBatchSize: 6,
  batchWaitMs: 15,
  maxConcurrentBatches: 4,
  enableAdaptive: true
}
```
Note: we advise starting with maxBatchSize 6 then tune down if latency SLOs fail.

kim_prod: From product side — recommend enabling adaptive batching on their route with target P95 latency 180ms. Also enable KV-prefix caching for user session prefixes; that was the big win for hit rate.

rahul_infra: Quick data dump:
- 24h hit rate: 32% (up from 18%)
- Avg batch size: 3.6 (was 4.2 pre-rollout)
- Cost per 1k tokens: $9.10 (was $12.40)
- 5xx rate: 0.22% (baseline 0.1%) — spike at 11:45 UTC coincides with a client-side retry loop flooding.

maria_cs: Action items:
- anika_success: schedule 30-min enablement with Sparrow eng (within 48h) — include client config and runbook.
- rahul_infra: add temporary rate-smoothing at edge to prevent retry flood and run root-cause on backpressure (ETA 24h).
- kim_prod: prepare renewal impact slide with projected savings (by end of week).

jake_csm: I'll loop in Sparrow's procurement and share projected TCO. If we can show ~25% unit cost reduction, they'll be more open to a 6mo commit.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment completed 03/12 12:03 UTC — 0 critical errors, 2 warnings (client backpressure observed).

anika_success: I'll also capture the customer's qualitative feedback in Salesforce: will flag "enablement requested" and "monitoring: P95 latency".

maria_cs: Thanks all. Let's reconvene in next weekly check; rahul if you find the root cause for the retry loop please ping here. :thumbsup:

rahul_infra: Will do — starting trace correlation now.

jake_csm: FYI I set a tentative renewal outreach calendar for 03/20.

maria_cs: Closing thread for now. Anything else, add here or DM. :rocket:
